title: maxmind_db: Cleanup upon getting an error
description:
If there is an error reading or writing to the pipes to the mmdbresolve
process, send a response to the main thread that will make it cleanup
all the mmdb resources, keeping future requests from being sent.

This prevents hanging if a shutdown occurs in the middle of a
synchronous lookup in tshark (e.g., CTRL-C in the terminal.)

Fix #18918
